description: This Java class 'ProductImagesController' is part of a Spring MVC web application, managing product image operations such as listing, adding, and removing images in the admin panel of an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductImagesController
classes.description: Controller class handling product image management in the admin interface, including listing, uploading, and deleting images for products.

methods.name: displayProductImages
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the images of a specific product, verifying permissions and product existence.

methods.name: pageProductImages
methods.description: Handles POST request to retrieve and respond with a JSON list of images associated with a product, for paging purposes.

methods.name: saveProductImages
methods.description: Handles POST request to upload and save new images for a product, validating input and permissions.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a specific product image, verifying permissions and existence before removal.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private method to set up menu context and active status for the admin interface.
